name: Lens Push
description: The second clip pushes the first out of frame as if seen through a wide-angle lens: the frame bulges and bends the seam while the clips speed past, with motion blur, color fringes toward the edges and a light vignette, then flattens back as the push lands. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction in which the clips move, snapped to the nearest of the 8 horizontal, vertical and diagonal directions (x right, y up)

params.name: strength
params.description: Strength of the lens bulge at the peak

params.name: fringe
params.description: Spread of the color fringes toward the edges

params.name: blur
params.description: Length of the motion blur at full speed
